understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate through each level and activate every goal cell by standing on it while the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one tile at a time in the cardinal directions, with walls blocking movement. Shape, color, and rotation modifiers change the carried piece: shape and color tiles cycle their respective attributes, while rotation tiles rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal only activates when all three attributes match simultaneously. Movement consumes stamina; exhausting stamina costs a life, and losing all lives ends the game. In this attempt, the piece needed rotation 0 degrees but had 270 degrees, requiring a rotation modifier at [19,30], and inefficient movement left insufficient stamina to reach it.
